headline: Gildan Shares Tumble 25% After Disappointing Q3 Earnings and Guidance Cut
summary: Shares of Gildan Activewear dropped 25% after the Canadian apparel maker reported weaker-than-expected Q3 results and lowered full-year revenue projections to $5.4 billion–$5.5 billion.
why: Gildan Activewear is a major North American manufacturer of basic apparel, fleece, and hosiery.

impacts.name: Gildan Activewear
impacts.why: Missing quarterly profit targets and cutting annual revenue outlook triggered a sharp 25% sell-off.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A quarterly revenue miss paired with a cut to full-year corporate revenue guidance prompted investor selling.
